```
/*
  Naming: --<tier>-<category>-<role>[-<variant>][-<state>]
  Tiers:  ref (raw values) -> sys (meaning, themeable) -> com (per component)
  Rule:   components read only com-*; com-* read only sys-*; sys-* read only ref-*.
  Partial on purpose: only the tokens needed by the examples are defined.
*/

@layer theme {
  /* Reference - raw palette and scales, never used directly in components */
  :root {
    --ref-neutral-0: #ffffff;
    --ref-neutral-100: #f3f4f6;
    --ref-neutral-300: #d1d5db;
    --ref-neutral-700: #374151;
    --ref-neutral-900: #111827;
    --ref-neutral-950: #030712;

    --ref-blue-300: #93c5fd;
    --ref-blue-600: #2563eb;
    --ref-blue-700: #1d4ed8;

    --ref-red-600: #dc2626;
    --ref-red-700: #b91c1c;

    --ref-space-1: 0.25rem;
    --ref-space-2: 0.5rem;
    --ref-space-3: 0.75rem;
    --ref-space-4: 1rem;

    --ref-radius-sm: 0.25rem;
    --ref-radius-md: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* System - semantic roles; the only tier a theme needs to override */
  :root {
    --sys-color-surface: var(--ref-neutral-0);
    --sys-color-surface-muted: var(--ref-neutral-100);
    --sys-color-on-surface: var(--ref-neutral-950);
    --sys-color-border: var(--ref-neutral-300);

    --sys-color-primary: var(--ref-blue-600);
    --sys-color-primary-hover: var(--ref-blue-700);
    --sys-color-on-primary: var(--ref-neutral-0);

    --sys-color-danger: var(--ref-red-600);
    --sys-color-danger-hover: var(--ref-red-700);
    --sys-color-on-danger: var(--ref-neutral-0);

    --sys-color-focus-ring: var(--ref-blue-600);

    --sys-space-inline: var(--ref-space-4);
    --sys-space-stack: var(--ref-space-2);
    --sys-radius-control: var(--ref-radius-md);
  }

  /* Dark theme - remaps sys roles only, ref and com stay untouched */
  [data-theme='dark'] {
    --sys-color-surface: var(--ref-neutral-950);
    --sys-color-surface-muted: var(--ref-neutral-900);
    --sys-color-on-surface: var(--ref-neutral-100);
    --sys-color-border: var(--ref-neutral-700);

    --sys-color-primary: var(--ref-blue-300);
    --sys-color-primary-hover: var(--ref-blue-600);
    --sys-color-on-primary: var(--ref-neutral-950);

    --sys-color-focus-ring: var(--ref-blue-300);
  }

  /* Component - button; variants/states are defined once, the component only consumes them */
  :root {
    --com-button-padding-block: var(--ref-space-2);
    --com-button-padding-inline: var(--sys-space-inline);
    --com-button-radius: var(--sys-radius-control);

    /* primary (default) */
    --com-button-surface: var(--sys-color-primary);
    --com-button-surface-hover: var(--sys-color-primary-hover);
    --com-button-on-surface: var(--sys-color-on-primary);

    /* danger variant */
    --com-button-danger-surface: var(--sys-color-danger);
    --com-button-danger-surface-hover: var(--sys-color-danger-hover);
    --com-button-danger-on-surface: var(--sys-color-on-danger);

    --com-button-focus-ring: var(--sys-color-focus-ring);
  }

  /* Component - text input */
  :root {
    --com-input-surface: var(--sys-color-surface);
    --com-input-on-surface: var(--sys-color-on-surface);
    --com-input-border: var(--sys-color-border);
    --com-input-border-focus: var(--sys-color-focus-ring);
    --com-input-border-invalid: var(--sys-color-danger);
    --com-input-radius: var(--sys-radius-control);
  }

  /* Local override - a single instance re-points one com token, with a fallback to the default */
  .promo-banner {
    --com-button-surface-hover: var(--promo-button-surface-hover, var(--ref-blue-300));
  }
}

/* Bridge to Tailwind utilities (bg-primary, text-on-primary, ...) */
@theme inline {
  --color-surface: var(--sys-color-surface);
  --color-on-surface: var(--sys-color-on-surface);
  --color-primary: var(--sys-color-primary);
  --color-on-primary: var(--sys-color-on-primary);
  --color-danger: var(--sys-color-danger);
}

```

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-5.5)**_

I rewrote `src/design/tokens.css` as a partial three-tier example. I haven't run it or opened it in Storybook, and nothing in `src` imports it yet.

- **Reference (`ref-*`):** raw neutral, blue and red values, plus a small space and radius scale.
- **System (`sys-*`):** semantic roles such as surface, on-surface, border, primary, danger and focus ring. A `[data-theme='dark']` block overrides only this tier.
- **Component (`com-*`):** one full button example (primary and danger, with hover states) and a text input. A `.promo-banner` rule shows a local override with a fallback.
- **Tailwind bridge:** an `@theme inline` block exposes a few `sys-*` colors as Tailwind colors (`bg-primary`, `text-on-primary` and so on).

I also fixed several problems in the old file:

- **Prefixes:** the file mixed `ds-` and `sys-`, which are now one scheme.
- **Typos:** the `---on-surface` and `suface` typos are gone.
- **Hover rule:** the hover rule nested inside `:root`, which never matched a hovered element, is removed.
- **Undefined variables:** references to variables that were never defined are gone.
- **Duplicated values:** component tokens that all pointed at the same value now point at distinct roles.

A comment at the top states the naming pattern and the rule that each tier reads only from the one below it.

I dropped the `--com-button-specjalny-ASBS-surface-hover` token. I couldn't tell what it was meant to show, so `.promo-banner` covers the override case instead. Tell me if you want the original back.
